from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitation(BaseModel):
    """Citation relationship information extracted from one paper in the collection."""
    paper_title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's full title")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper references in its bibliography")
    cited_by: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper in their text or references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate of citation data from all provided papers."""
    papers: list[PaperCitation]
